help.short: The name of the lab that uniquely identifies it within containing lab plan. Used in resource URIs.
The ID of the virtual machine that uniquely identifies it within the containing lab. Used in resource URIs.

description: Get the properties for a lab virtual machine.

operations.description: Returns the properties for a lab virtual machine.

params.description: The name of the lab that uniquely identifies it within containing lab plan. Used in resource URIs.
params.name: labName

params.description: The name of the resource group. The name is case insensitive.
params.name: resourceGroupName

params.description: The ID of the target subscription.
params.name: subscriptionId

params.description: The ID of the virtual machine that uniquely identifies it within the containing lab. Used in resource URIs.
params.name: virtualMachineName

consts.description: The API version to use for this operation.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: Fully qualified resource ID for the resource. Ex - /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/{resourceProviderNamespace}/{resourceType}/{resourceName}
props.name: id

props.description: The name of the resource
props.name: name

props.description: Virtual machine resource properties
props.name: properties

props.description: The lab user ID (not the PUID!) of who claimed the virtual machine.
props.name: claimedByUserId

props.description: Profile for information about connecting to the virtual machine.
props.name: connectionProfile

props.description: The username used to log on to the virtual machine as admin.
props.name: adminUsername

props.description: The username used to log on to the virtual machine as non-admin, if one exists.
props.name: nonAdminUsername

props.description: The private IP address of the virtual machine.
props.name: privateIpAddress

props.description: Port and host name separated by semicolon for connecting via RDP protocol to the virtual machine.
props.name: rdpAuthority

props.description: URL for connecting via RDP protocol to the virtual machine in browser.
props.name: rdpInBrowserUrl

props.description: Port and host name separated by semicolon for connecting via SSH protocol to the virtual machine.
props.name: sshAuthority

props.description: URL for connecting via SSH protocol to the virtual machine in browser.
props.name: sshInBrowserUrl

props.description: Current provisioning state of the virtual machine.
props.name: provisioningState

props.description: The current state of the virtual machine
props.name: state

props.description: The type of this VM resource
props.name: vmType

props.description: System data of the Lab virtual machine.
props.name: systemData

props.description: The timestamp of resource creation (UTC).
props.name: createdAt

props.description: The identity that created the resource.
props.name: createdBy

props.description: The type of identity that created the resource.
props.name: createdByType

props.description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)
props.name: lastModifiedAt

props.description: The identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedBy

props.description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.
props.name: lastModifiedByType

props.description: The type of the resource. E.g. "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines" or "Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts"
props.name: type
